question: Raj takes twice as much time as Sujay and thrice as much time as Ronak to finish a piece of work. If Sujay can do the work alone in 6 days, then in how many days all three together can finish the same work.

Raj takes twice as much time as Sujay to finish the work

Raj takes thrice as much time as Ronak to finish the work
